title: 7S.2c.d.17.26 single-field strict text encode
mode: local implementation with focused generated verification
scope: Avoid the temporary vector<string> chunk container for one strict semantic DXF text value
Share strict profile/scalar validation and target encoding between single-field and chunked writers
Avoid redundant lvalue copies in internal semantic string/capitalized-symbol writer calls

changes.gitStatus: uncommitted; shared worktree is broadly dirty and Git metadata is read-only

implementation.details: Strict fromUtf8String now validates and appends encoded scalars directly to one result string rather than allocating a vector<string> and one chunk string. Chunked paths reuse the same strict-profile and per-scalar helpers. Internal semantic text writer methods accept const std::string&; uppercase symbol output creates one transformed copy. Caller input remains unchanged.
preservedPolicies: NUL and ASCII CR/LF record framing refusal
DXF target-version and legacy codepage profile admission
implementation.limits: This is not general allocation/RSS accounting and does not optimize MTEXT chunking, binary-hex scratch, or text projection copies.
